lines.text: The writer tells the little children to remain in Christ so they may be confident and unashamed when He appears.
The Father's love means believers are called servants of the King, and they will be like Christ when He appears.
Everyone who has this hope in Christ purifies himself, and Christ appeared to take away sins.
The one who practices sin is of the devil, and the Son of David was revealed to destroy his works.
Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, and anyone who does not love his brother is not of God.
